description: Retries the failed work of an analysis at no charge. Use it only when qualitative_get_run shows `retry_available` true (`action_required` retry_or_cancel), and after the user agreed. Requires sign-in (OAuth connector or API key) with the runs:write scope, and the key's owner must own the analysis. On an analysis that has not failed it answers a conflict error. It does not re-run a finished analysis: for a new analysis use qualitative_start_analysis. Afterwards poll with qualitative_get_run.

idempotency_key.description: Optional key (printable ASCII, at most 255 characters). Pass idempotency_key to make your own retries safe: repeating the call with the same key returns the original result instead of acting again. If omitted, every call gets its own fresh key.

run_id.description: The analysis id (`run_id`) from qualitative_list_runs or qualitative_start_analysis.

name: qualitative_retry_analysis
title: Retry failed analysis work
